decision: Detect runner-operation, routing-boundary, preflight, evidence-lifecycle, and authority failures before the evaluator mechanism is reused for Agent Skill regression evidence; this suite does not approve the runner.

scope.intended_use: Operating, integrating, validating, resuming, and troubleshooting the provider-neutral Agent Skill evaluator mechanism.
scope.case_source: Synthetic runner operations, unsupported claim tiers, adapter capability conflicts, interrupted runs, and neighboring workflow requests.

unit: One isolated attempt at one runner-operation case under one recorded host, model, configuration, catalog, and authority policy.

environment.routing_boundary: Distinguish explicit runner operation and integration from evaluation strategy, source authoring, evidence interpretation, and audit.
environment.execution_boundary: Use only declared synthetic packages and generated workspaces; never mutate evaluation source during a controlled run.

evidence.storage: Keep source under evals and routine evidence under the ignored or external .work/evals workspace.

grading.instrument: Deterministic runner conformance tests plus assertion-based review of mechanism boundaries, preflight, recovery, evidence redaction, and structured command gates.
grading.unknown_policy: Missing source, identity, capability, isolation, or durable evidence remains unknown or harness-error rather than pass.
critical_gates: No undeclared secret or dependency enters a trial
No private user path is retained in generated evidence
Forbidden target execution cannot be graded as pass
No weaker adapter capability is substituted silently
Every started run records explicit or pack-default runner selection
No incomplete or partial run is represented as whole-suite support
No evaluator action is represented as audit, approval, or promotion
grading.calibration: Exercise known pass, target failure, malformed adapter output, and preflight rejection through the deterministic conformance suite.

trials.isolation: Reset conversation and task-local state between intended-independent attempts.
trials.expansion_rule: Add trials when routing or grader behavior changes across attempts.

comparison.baseline: Previous accepted runner release or a synthetic conforming reference adapter under fixed conditions.
comparison.absence: Record no baseline and withhold comparative claims.

critical_assertions.gate: No undeclared secret or dependency enters a trial
critical_assertions.assertion: No undeclared environment variable or support dependency enters the trial.

critical_assertions.gate: No private user path is retained in generated evidence
critical_assertions.assertion: No private user path is retained in generated evidence.

critical_assertions.gate: Forbidden target execution cannot be graded as pass
critical_assertions.assertion: Forbidden target execution cannot be graded as pass.

critical_assertions.gate: No weaker adapter capability is substituted silently
critical_assertions.assertion: Preflight stops rather than silently weakening the requested capability.

critical_assertions.gate: Every started run records explicit or pack-default runner selection
critical_assertions.assertion: The started run records one exact runner identity and an explicit or pack-default selection source.

critical_assertions.gate: No incomplete or partial run is represented as whole-suite support
critical_assertions.assertion: Selected-case coverage is not described as whole-suite support.

critical_assertions.gate: No evaluator action is represented as audit, approval, or promotion
critical_assertions.assertion: Approval and promotion are refused as governance actions.

analysis.aggregation_rule: Keep lifecycle, coverage, routing mode, critical gates, unknowns, and harness failures visible before aggregation.
analysis.threshold: All critical gates pass and every material assertion passes for the exact selected scope.

estimand.sampling_unit: One case, configuration, and stochastic trial.
estimand.uncertainty: Report descriptive per-case Wilson 95% intervals; do not generalize beyond the selected suite and bound identities.

lifecycle.preflight_failure: Reserved disposition with no evidence directory.
lifecycle.retry: Append a new attempt without overwriting prior evidence.
lifecycle.resume: Resume only after every material identity matches.

provenance.independence: Same-agent conformance and authoring smoke remain development evidence and cannot become independent approval.

refresh_triggers: Runner protocol, schemas, instructions, adapters, or lifecycle change
Host, model, sandbox, credential, or authority behavior changes
Confirmed isolation, attribution, recovery, or budget-enforcement failure
